body:
## Why (verified evidence)

`validate-structured-store` accepts communication-synthesis stores whose entries contain no renderable text (only whitespace mentions, empty thesis, or `pub` objects without `src`), then every synthesis render CLI fails during adaptation with `communication store has no renderable entry text`.

- `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py:245-311` walks mentions, thesis, and publication evidence but never requires that at least one entry would project to a renderer record.
- `src/deliverable_render/store/communication.py:111-112` only appends a mention record when mention text is non-blank after strip or a `src` pointer is present; `communication.py:123-124` skips blank thesis strings; `communication.py:136` requires `pub.src` before a publication record exists.
- `src/deliverable_render/store/communication.py:151-152` raises when the adapted record list is empty after validation succeeded.

User-facing consequence: a store that passes the documented validator still cannot render HTML, PPTX, or DOCX.

## Reproduction

```bash
cd /path/to/Deliverable-Render
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from deliverable_render.store.validate import validate_store
from deliverable_render.cli.render_html import main as html_main

store = Path("tests/fixtures/stores/communication_render.json")
paths = Path("tests/fixtures/stores/communication_paths.json")
data = json.loads(store.read_text())
period = data["periods"][0]["id"]
data["entries"] = [{
    "id": "solo",
    "name": "Solo",
    "first": period,
    "mentions": [{"q": period, "text": "   "}],
}]
p = Path("/tmp/no-renderable.json")
p.write_text(json.dumps(data))
assert validate_store(p).valid
rc = html_main(["--store", str(p), "--document-paths", str(paths), "--out", "/tmp/hub.html"])
assert rc == 2
print("validate=pass render=fail OK")
PY
```

## Tasks

- [ ] In `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py` after the per-entry loop (near `:311`), add a renderability check that mirrors `adapt_store` rules in `communication.py:111-112`, `:123-124`, and `:136-150`: fail when no mention would emit (non-blank text or `src` pointer), no nonempty thesis, and no `pub` with `src`.
- [ ] In `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py:41-42` register a new issue code (for example `no-renderable-content`) with a path on `/entries` and a message that names the empty render projection.
- [ ] In `tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py:385-396` extend `test_blank_unsourced_mention_is_skipped` (or add a sibling test) to assert `validate_store` returns invalid with that code before calling `adapt_store`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Named test: `tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py::test_blank_unsourced_mention_is_skipped` (or a new test beside it) asserts the whitespace-only mention fixture fails `validate_store` with code `no-renderable-content` (or the chosen code).
- Deliberate-break → revert: temporarily remove the new validation block in `validate.py` → confirm that named test FAILS → revert.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change `adapt_store` projection rules or require document-path mappings inside `validate_store` (paths remain render-time only).
- No scaffolding / TODO-only changes; every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.

_Surfaced by Track D repo-audit 2026-09-23; verified on tip `a867f3f` by running the Reproduction block and reading cited lines._
title: [P2] Store with no renderable entry text passes validate-structured-store then fails at render
